slides.title: Day 1. You run a flower shop. It's holiday season.
slides.body: Wreath orders are already stacking up.

slides.label: Day 3
slides.title: You hire two seasonal designers.
slides.body: Nobody wrote down which paperwork they still owe you.

slides.label: Day 6
slides.title: The hotel wants your insurance certificate for the lobby install.
slides.body: The one in your inbox says 2025.

slides.label: Day 9
slides.title: The delivery van's registration sticker looks... old.
slides.body: You decide not to look closer. The van has 40 stops today.

slides.label: Day 12
slides.title: A letter about the business license renewal.
slides.body: It's been under the ribbon spools since October.

slides.label: Day 15
slides.title: The phone rings. It's the hotel again.
slides.body: What happens next? Wrong answers only.
